description: Implementation of SRS (Sounding Reference Signal) scheduler logic for 5G NR, including resource management, UE configuration, and scheduling functions.

classes.name: srs_scheduler_impl
classes.description: Class implementing the SRS scheduling logic, managing resources, UE configurations, and scheduling slots.

methods.name: create_srs_pdu
methods.description: Helper function to generate an SRS info PDU for a given SRS resource.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Executes scheduling for a slot, allocating SRS opportunities.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler, clearing internal states.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE configuration to the scheduler.

methods.name: add_ue_to_grid
methods.description: Adds a UE's SRS resources to the scheduling grid.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE's SRS resources from the grid.

methods.name: reconf_ue
methods.description: Reconfigures a UE's SRS resources based on new configuration.

methods.name: handle_positioning_measurement_request
methods.description: Handles a positioning measurement request, scheduling SRS resources accordingly.

methods.name: handle_positioning_measurement_stop
methods.description: Stops a positioning measurement for a given RNTI.

methods.name: schedule_slot_srs
methods.description: Schedules SRS opportunities for a specific slot.

methods.name: schedule_updated_ues_srs
methods.description: Schedules SRS for UEs that have been recently added or reconfigured.

methods.name: allocate_srs_opportunity
methods.description: Allocates an SRS opportunity in a slot for a specific resource.

methods.name: add_resource
methods.description: Adds an SRS resource for a UE with specified periodicity and offset.

methods.name: rem_resource
methods.description: Removes an SRS resource for a UE with specified periodicity and offset.

methods.name: get_ue_cfg
methods.description: Retrieves UE configuration for a given RNTI.
